title: Sparkly tent
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tentBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff8a5c"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e04a2a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tentDoor" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd166"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f4a700"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="42" ry="6" fill="#2e6b4f"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="85" rx="40" ry="5" fill="#3a8a63"/>

  <!-- tent main triangle -->
  <polygon points="50,18 14,82 86,82" fill="url(#tentBody)"/>

  <!-- tent front panel (lighter) -->
  <polygon points="50,18 50,82 86,82" fill="#ff9f6e" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- tent ridge highlight -->
  <line x1="50" y1="18" x2="50" y2="82" stroke="#ffcf9e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- tent pole tip -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="3" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="1.5" fill="#fff8d6"/>

  <!-- door flap -->
  <polygon points="50,50 34,82 66,82" fill="url(#tentDoor)"/>
  <polygon points="50,50 50,82 66,82" fill="#ffe08a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#fff4c2"/>

  <!-- door opening dark interior (lit dark purple) -->
  <polygon points="50,56 39,82 61,82" fill="#4a3a7a"/>
  <polygon points="50,56 50,82 61,82" fill="#5d4a94" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- tent side accent stripe -->
  <line x1="22" y1="70" x2="36" y2="50" stroke="#ffd8b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="70" x2="64" y2="50" stroke="#ffd8b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#fff4a3">
    <polygon points="20,24 22,30 28,32 22,34 20,40 18,34 12,32 18,30"/>
    <polygon points="78,16 79.5,20 83,21.5 79.5,23 78,27 76.5,23 73,21.5 76.5,20"/>
    <polygon points="86,44 87,47 90,48 87,49 86,52 85,49 82,48 85,47"/>
    <polygon points="10,52 11,55 14,56 11,57 10,60 9,57 6,56 9,55"/>
    <polygon points="34,12 35,15 38,16 35,17 34,20 33,17 30,16 33,15"/>
    <polygon points="66,8 66.8,10.5 69,11.3 66.8,12.1 66,14.5 65.2,12.1 63,11.3 65.2,10.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle glows -->
  <g fill="#fff8cc" opacity="0.7">
    <circle cx="20" cy="32" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="78" cy="21.5" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="86" cy="48" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="10" cy="56" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="16" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="11.3" r="1.2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny stars -->
  <g fill="#c9b8ff" opacity="0.8">
    <circle cx="42" cy="10" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="14" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="30" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="36" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="28" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="8" cy="38" r="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>
